description: Interactive frontend & risk integration: Upgrade forecast.blade.php with Chart.js dual-line graph (historical + forecast + confidence band), responsive dark mode styling, integrate forecast data into DroughtAnalyzer::riskScore(), and update package.json with Chart.js dependency.
steps: Update package.json: Add 'chart.js' to dependencies (e.g., '^4.4.0'). Run npm install.

Update resources/views/back/drought/consumption/forecast.blade.php. Modify each forecast card to replace static bar chart with interactive Chart.js canvas. (1) For each zone, prepare data structure: historical_months (array), historical_values (array), forecast_months (array), forecast_values (array), lower_bounds (array), upper_bounds (array). (2) Initialize Chart.js with configuration: type='line', dual datasets (historical solid line, forecast dashed line), fill between upper/lower for confidence band, responsive, dark mode colors (use CSS variable or inline colors based on $theme). (3) Include in Blade via inline <script> or Alpine x-data binding. (4) Add tooltip formatter to display month, value in French. (5) Add legend with labels: 'Historique', 'Prévision', 'Intervalle de confiance'.
Modify app/Http/Controllers/Back/ConsumptionReadingController::forecast() to fetch ConsumptionForecast records for each zone and pass to view as $forecasts[$i]['consumption_forecasts'] array.

Modify app/Services/DroughtAnalyzer::riskScore(Zone $zone) to integrate forecast: (1) Fetch latest ConsumptionForecast for the zone. (2) If forecast exists: if prediction shows >15% decline vs. baseline over 6 months, add 10 points to risk. If lower_bound < critical threshold (e.g., 5% of typical), add 15 points. (3) Include in $facteurs array: 'Prévision d'une consommation en hausse / baisse significative.'
Verify styling: navigate to /back/consumption-readings/previsions in light mode and dark mode; confirm Chart.js renders, confidence band visible, colors correct.
Run npm run build to compile assets.
acceptance_criteria: npm install completes successfully with Chart.js in node_modules.
forecast.blade.php displays interactive Chart.js graph for each zone.
Graph shows historical data (solid line), forecast (dashed line), confidence band (shaded area).
Graph is responsive and works on mobile view.
Dark mode classes (dark:text-white, dark:bg-gray-800) applied correctly.
Month labels in French (janvier, février, etc.).
riskScore() includes forecast data in calculation (reflected in score + $facteurs).
No console errors in browser dev tools.
verification: Inspect page source or browser inspector: <canvas> elements present with Chart.js initialization
Toggle dark mode (if theme toggle available): colors adapt
Mouse over chart line/points: tooltip shows French month + value

Call php artisan tinker: $zone = Zone::find(1); $drought = app('App\Services\DroughtAnalyzer'); $risk = $drought->riskScore($zone); dd($risk); (confirm $facteurs includes forecast-based messages if forecast exists)
